title: Ogni giorno si cantano canzoni d'amore
scene: Italian singer-songwriter tradition / early Sanremo repertoire
notes: Early author-led songs mix intimate writing, abortion commentary, orchestral studio pop and Sanremo repertoire.

title: Donatella Rettore
notes: Socially confrontational songwriter material gains forceful percussion, pop-rock movement and Massara orchestration.

title: Brivido divino
scene: Italian late-1970s rock/disco crossover and commercial pop
notes: Disco-rock crossover reveals synthesizers, theatrical vocal characters and identity-focused lyrics beyond its signature single.

title: Magnifico delirio
notes: Kobra shares space with surreal Gaio, provocative Benvenuto and Delirio’s processed voices and strings.

title: Estasi clamorosa
scene: Italian post-disco / early-1980s television pop and ska
notes: Ska breakthrough amid guitar-driven pop, keyboards, organ, sax and contrasting songs.

title: Kamikaze Rock 'n' Roll Suicide
scene: Italian new wave / synth-pop concept album
influenced_by: Siouxsie and the Banshees|Joy Division|Soft Cell|Talking Heads|Devo|Blondie
notes: Angular new-wave concept album contrasts abrasive garage rhythms, programmed synths and intimate piano tragedy.

title: Far West
scene: Italian conceptual electronic pop-rock / Western theatrical imagery
notes: Western-themed theatrical pop-rock contrasts adventurous electronics, saxophone and an Elton John composition.

title: Danceteria
notes: Synth-pop surfaces mingle with live guitars, reeds and unexpectedly tender dramatic songs.
